subject: Mapping audit log fields to retention SLAs — BYOK/SSO scoping
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-01-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: BYO/SS log field mapping — scope ask

Team —

Heads-up: MediWell's audit team sent a short requirements doc (attached) and a sample event stream. Their ask is twofold: 1) confirm we can surface the explicit KMS key-id / wrap/unwrapping events in audit logs for BYOK customers, and 2) that SSO assertions (SAML/OIDC) are recorded with an immutable session identifier and retention label so they can meet a 7-year retention SLA for regulated records.

Questions for product/infra:
- Do we currently emit a stable, queryable field for kms_key_id on every encrypt/decrypt event?
- Can we attach a retention label to log entries at write time (and preserve it through compression/archival)?
- Any blockers in the serving runtime for adding an sso_assertion_id or session_hash in the audit stream?

I've attached their PDF + a brief sample log. MediWell is asking for confirmation this week so we can include scoped inputs for the Dedicated/Private rollout.

Michael
Senior Infra PM — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MediWell_audit_requirements_v2.pdf, example_audit_log_sample.jsonl

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-26T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BYO/SS log field mapping — scope ask

Michael — thanks for the ping and attaching the sample. Quick notes from infra/product perspective after a first pass:

- kms_key_id: our current cryptographic capture emits a key fingerprint but not the customer's full key identifier for BYOK-managed keys (we intentionally redact full ARNs for multi-tenant hosted flows). For Dedicated/Private customers we can surface the full key-id, but that'll require a small upstream change in the keystore/proxy to record the external key_id on the event path.

- retention_label: we do have a metadata map per-logline (storage labels) but those are applied at ingest; archival tooling currently strips some labels when using gzip->coldstore unless a preserve flag is set. Should be fixable but needs QA across retention/restore flows.

- sso_assertion/session_hash: runtime currently emits session_id for interactive tokens but not the SAML assertion id. Adding assertion_id should be low-risk (header passthrough + hash) but we'll need to confirm alignment with privacy (we can't log raw assertions).

I'll pull in infra owners and estimate gating work: keystore change (~3 dev days + 2 days QA), retention-label preservation (~4 dev days + SRE rollout), assertion_id field (~2 dev days). These are rough.

Priya
Director, Product — Security & Compliance

From: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@mediwell.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-team@mediwell.com
Date: 2027-01-26T13:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BYO/SS log field mapping — scope ask

Michael — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from our end:

- For kms_key_id we need an auditable reference that matches our KMS (we're a BYOK customer and must be able to map every wrap event to our key, the ARN is ideal). We understand token redaction needs care; a hashed ARN that is reversible by our audit process would work if you prefer not to store clear ARNs in hosted logs.

- For SSO evidence: we do not want the raw assertion, but the assertion_id (SAML ID) + subject + timestamp is sufficient. We also need proof that the assertion was validated (status) so an assertion_valid boolean is helpful.

- Regarding retention: our regulator requires 7 years on certain PII-linked events; we can provide an allowlist of event types.

Can you confirm whether Redwood would be comfortable providing a reversible mapping for key identifiers for Dedicated customers (or a short-term escrow process)? We have a procurement deadline end of next week.

Jordan Lane
Security & Compliance Lead — MediWell Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-27T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BYO/SS log field mapping — scope ask

Quick operational readout:

- Reversible mapping for key ARNs: feasible but adds legal/ops considerations (we'd need a KMS-escrow policy and access controls). For Dedicated/Private customers we can store the ARN in the customer-controlled vault; for Hosted we should default to salted HMAC with customer-provided salt to allow reversible lookup if necessary.

- Performance: tagging every token/encrypt event with an extra field will increase log volume by ~8-12% for affected calls. We can limit to events that touch PII (per MediWell's allowlist) to reduce cost.

- Timeline proposal: small pilot for 2 enterprise accounts in March (proof-of-concept + validation), then baked into Dedicated April/May rollout. Dev effort aligns with Priya's estimates.

I'll open a short Jira for pilot work and coordinate with SRE for retention-label preservation tests.

Jonas
Staff Engineer, Security Systems

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@mediwell.com>, audit-team@mediwell.com
Date: 2027-01-28T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BYO/SS log field mapping — scope ask

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Action items and owners: 

- Priya: confirm final dev estimates and whether assertion_id logging requires a privacy review (owner: Priya). Due: 2027-01-29 EOD.
- Jonas: create Jira ticket SECOPS-1229 and add pilot acceptance criteria + telemetry delta. Start: 2027-02-01.
- Grace: coordinate with Legal/Contracts on reversible-key-ARN clauses for Dedicated customers and a short-term escrow option for procurement. Due: 2027-01-31.
- Jordan/MediWell: send allowlist of event types that require 7-year retention and confirm whether reversible mapping is acceptable. Requested by: 2027-01-29.

We'll run a 30-minute sync Friday 2027-01-29 1400 PST to close the procurement questions — invite sent. If anyone sees blockers earlier, flag in the Jira.

Michael
Senior Infra PM — Redwood Inference
